# openclaw-sub (clawsub) — Agent Discovery Summary

## What it does
Runs OpenClaw 24/7 on flat-rate AI subscriptions (Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Google AI)
with $0 extra API bills and automatic 0ms quota failover between CLIs.

## Install
```
npx openclaw-sub@latest install
```
Or one-line Ubuntu bootstrapper (22.04 / 24.04):
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ecimionatto/openclaw-sub/main/scripts/bootstrap-ubuntu.sh | bash
```

## Key CLI commands
```
clawsub install          # bootstrap OpenClaw + subscription CLIs
clawsub status           # show provider cooldown states
clawsub doctor           # diagnose auth and CLI availability
clawsub version          # print installed versions
clawsub route <prompt>   # route a single prompt through the failover chain
```

## Architecture (failover chain)
User → OpenClaw Gateway → clawsub Cooldown Router
  → claude CLI  (Claude Pro/Max — primary)
  → codex CLI   (ChatGPT Plus/Pro — fallback #1)
  → agy/gemini  (Google AI — fallback #2)
  → ollama      (local hardware — optional offline fallback)

When a provider hits its 5-hour or weekly quota limit, clawsub records the exact reset time
and skips that provider with 0ms overhead on every subsequent turn until the cooldown expires.

## Cross-model session baton
When failover occurs, clawsub writes a compact session baton (src/baton.mjs) containing the
conversation summary, last decisions, and pending task state so the next model can continue
without amnesia.

## Zero external dependencies
Node.js >= 18 built-ins only. `npx openclaw-sub` executes instantly with no install step.

## Repository
https://github.com/ecimionatto/openclaw-sub
